title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: Tender beef skewers grilled to perfection, inspired by the flavors of Argentina. This recipe is perfect for a summer evening or a backyard BBQ.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, oregano, red pepper flakes, and olive oil.
3. Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread the beef, red onion, and oregano onto skewers.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
7. Transfer the skewers to a serving platter and serve with lemon wedges.
